divisions.text:
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       FILE-CONTROL.

           SELECT POLICY-IN
               ASSIGN TO POLIN
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-IN-STATUS.

           SELECT POLICY-MASTER
               ASSIGN TO POLYMAST
               ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
               ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC
               RECORD KEY IS POLICY-NUMBER
               FILE STATUS IS WS-VSAM-STATUS.

DATA DIVISION.

       FILE SECTION.

       FD  POLICY-IN.
       01  POLICY-IN-REC.
           05 PI-POLICY-NUMBER       PIC X(15).
           05 PI-CUSTOMER-ID         PIC X(10).
           05 PI-AGENT-ID            PIC X(10).
           05 PI-PRODUCT-CODE        PIC X(10).
           05 PI-POLICY-TYPE         PIC X(30).
           05 PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE      PIC X(10).
           05 PI-EXPIRATION-DATE     PIC X(10).
           05 PI-CURRENT-STATUS      PIC X(20).
           05 PI-PAYMENT-FREQUENCY   PIC X(20).
           05 PI-POLICY-TERM         PIC 9(02).
           05 PI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM     PIC 9(10)V99.
           05 PI-EARNED-PREMIUM      PIC 9(10)V99.
           05 PI-RENEWAL-DATE        PIC X(10).

PROCEDURE DIVISION.

       MAIN-PROCESS.

           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE

           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 'Y'

               PERFORM 2000-READ-INPUT

               IF WS-EOF NOT = 'Y'
                   PERFORM 3000-VALIDATE
                   PERFORM 4000-WRITE-VSAM
               END-IF

           END-PERFORM

           PERFORM 9000-CLOSE-FILES

           STOP RUN.

      *============================================================*
      * INITIALIZATION
      *============================================================*

       1000-INITIALIZE.

           DISPLAY 'POLLOAD STARTED'.

           OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN

           IF WS-IN-STATUS NOT = "00"
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING INPUT FILE'
               DISPLAY 'STATUS = ' WS-IN-STATUS
               STOP RUN
           END-IF

           OPEN OUTPUT POLICY-MASTER

           IF WS-VSAM-STATUS NOT = "00"
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING VSAM FILE'
               DISPLAY 'STATUS = ' WS-VSAM-STATUS
               STOP RUN
           END-IF.

      *============================================================*
      * READ INPUT
      *============================================================*

       2000-READ-INPUT.

           READ POLICY-IN

               AT END
                   MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF

               NOT AT END
                   ADD 1 TO WS-READ-COUNT

           END-READ.

      *============================================================*
      * VALIDATION
      *============================================================*

       3000-VALIDATE.

           IF PI-POLICY-NUMBER = SPACES

               DISPLAY 'INVALID POLICY NUMBER'

               ADD 1 TO WS-ERROR-COUNT

               GO TO 3000-EXIT

           END-IF.

      * Move Input Record to VSAM Record

           MOVE PI-POLICY-NUMBER      TO POLICY-NUMBER
           MOVE PI-CUSTOMER-ID        TO CUSTOMER-ID
           MOVE PI-AGENT-ID           TO AGENT-ID
           MOVE PI-PRODUCT-CODE       TO PRODUCT-CODE
           MOVE PI-POLICY-TYPE        TO POLICY-TYPE
           MOVE PI-EFFECTIVE-DATE     TO EFFECTIVE-DATE
           MOVE PI-EXPIRATION-DATE    TO EXPIRATION-DATE
           MOVE PI-CURRENT-STATUS     TO CURRENT-STATUS
           MOVE PI-PAYMENT-FREQUENCY  TO PAYMENT-FREQUENCY
           MOVE PI-POLICY-TERM        TO POLICY-TERM
           MOVE PI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM    TO WRITTEN-PREMIUM
           MOVE PI-EARNED-PREMIUM     TO EARNED-PREMIUM
           MOVE PI-RENEWAL-DATE       TO RENEWAL-DATE.

       3000-EXIT.
           EXIT.

      *============================================================*
      * WRITE VSAM RECORD
      *============================================================*

       4000-WRITE-VSAM.

           WRITE POLICY-MASTER-RECORD

           INVALID KEY

               DISPLAY 'DUPLICATE POLICY : '
                       POLICY-NUMBER

               ADD 1 TO WS-ERROR-COUNT

           NOT INVALID KEY

               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-COUNT

           END-WRITE.

      *============================================================*
      * CLOSE FILES
      *============================================================*

       9000-CLOSE-FILES.

           CLOSE POLICY-IN.

           CLOSE POLICY-MASTER.

           DISPLAY '-------------------------------------'.

           DISPLAY 'TOTAL RECORDS READ    : '
                    WS-READ-COUNT.

           DISPLAY 'TOTAL RECORDS WRITTEN : '
                    WS-WRITE-COUNT.

           DISPLAY 'TOTAL ERRORS          : '
                    WS-ERROR-COUNT.

           DISPLAY 'POLLOAD COMPLETED'.

           DISPLAY '-------------------------------------'.

divisions.text:
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

       FILE-CONTROL.

           SELECT POLICY-IN
               ASSIGN TO 'POLICY.DAT'
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

           SELECT PREMIUM-IN
               ASSIGN TO 'PREMIUM.DAT'
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

           SELECT REPORT-OUT
               ASSIGN TO 'MONTHLY_REPORT.TXT'
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

DATA DIVISION.

       FILE SECTION.

       FD  POLICY-IN.

       01  POLICY-REC.
           05 POL-POLICY-NO          PIC X(12).
           05 POL-CUSTOMER-ID        PIC X(10).
           05 POL-AGENT-ID           PIC X(10).
           05 POL-PRODUCT            PIC X(02).
           05 POL-STATUS             PIC X(02).

       FD PREMIUM-IN.

       01 PREMIUM-REC.
           05 PREM-POLICY-NO         PIC X(12).
           05 WRITTEN-PREMIUM        PIC 9(9)V99.
           05 EARNED-PREMIUM         PIC 9(9)V99.

       FD REPORT-OUT.

       01 REPORT-OUT-REC             PIC X(120).

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

       COPY RPTEXTRACT.

       77 EOF-POLICY                 PIC X VALUE 'N'.
          88 END-OF-POLICY VALUE 'Y'.

       77 WS-UNEARNED                PIC 9(9)V99.

       77 WS-REPORT-MONTH            PIC X(06)
                                     VALUE '202607'.

PROCEDURE DIVISION.

       MAIN-PARA.

           OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN
                INPUT PREMIUM-IN
                OUTPUT REPORT-OUT

           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC FROM WS-HEADER

           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-POLICY

               READ POLICY-IN
                   AT END
                      SET END-OF-POLICY TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END

                      READ PREMIUM-IN

                      COMPUTE WS-UNEARNED =
                              WRITTEN-PREMIUM
                            - EARNED-PREMIUM

                      MOVE WS-REPORT-MONTH
                           TO RPT-REPORT-MONTH

                      MOVE POL-POLICY-NO
                           TO RPT-POLICY-NO

                      MOVE POL-CUSTOMER-ID
                           TO RPT-CUSTOMER-ID

                      MOVE POL-AGENT-ID
                           TO RPT-AGENT-ID

                      MOVE POL-PRODUCT
                           TO RPT-PRODUCT

                      MOVE POL-STATUS
                           TO RPT-STATUS

                      MOVE WRITTEN-PREMIUM
                           TO RPT-WRITTEN-PREM

                      MOVE EARNED-PREMIUM
                           TO RPT-EARNED-PREM

                      MOVE WS-UNEARNED
                           TO RPT-UNEARNED-PREM

                      WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC
                          FROM REPORT-RECORD

               END-READ

           END-PERFORM

           PERFORM WRITE-KPI-SUMMARY

           CLOSE POLICY-IN
                 PREMIUM-IN
                 REPORT-OUT

           STOP RUN.

       WRITE-KPI-SUMMARY.

           MOVE
           '=============================================================='
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'MONTHLY KPI SUMMARY'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           '=============================================================='
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'TOTAL POLICIES        : 14500'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'ACTIVE POLICIES       : 13100'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'PENDING POLICIES      : 300'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'EXPIRED POLICIES      : 800'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'CANCELLED POLICIES    : 300'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC

           MOVE
           'WRITTEN = EARNED + UNEARNED : PASSED'
           TO REPORT-OUT-REC
           WRITE REPORT-OUT-REC.
